page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, full width. No marginal notes. A catchword at the lower right. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: annis Chrysostomi, qui tibi de hoc argu-
mento plura suppeditabunt.
De Confessione auriculari, & expressio-
ne peccatorum singulorum egimus in Hot-
tingero; quod eodem modo atque Græci
exequuntur Pontificij. Et hæc est vera con-
cordia, quam non convellit, neque quæ-
stus Pontificius, neque intermissio Con-
fessionis Sacerdotum Græcorum, neque
alia singularia hominum dubia, cum con-
cordia plurium fit, non unius, vel alterius
disputantis, aut contendentis. Et cum di-
cit Latinus Confessionem exercendam absque
quæstu, neque debito tempore intermit-
tendam, & Græcus etiam hoc dicit, non
soluit consensum, si quis parere dedignans
hic quæstum inhiat, ille Confessionem in-
termittit: Neque enim omnes in Ecclesia
præceptis Ecclesiasticis semper obediunt.
Et quis animis rebellibus modum con-sti-
tuet? Raro tamen antecedentem scelestum
deseruit pœna pede claudo, aiebat ille, cum
ob simile delictum, sicut etiam alia a Deo,
vel hominibus tarde, vel cito pœnæ ex-
petantur.
De Extrema unctione Verba illa Iacobi:

l.i: Si quis infirmatur, vocet Presbyteros Ecclesiæ,
& imponant ei manus, ungentes eum oleo in no-
mine Domini, & oratio Fidei salvabit infirmum,

page.notes: The catchword "etsi" is set in italic at the lower right and is kept as catchword only. A faint small mark appears at the foot of the page, centre; it is not clearly printed text and is left out. The reading "poena" versus "pœna" in one line, and the "s" in "saluabit", are slightly uncertain; the text was read as "pœnæ" and "salvabit" (v as consonant). The page number is printed as "5oo" in old form and is given as 500.
